name: Woodpaw Den
summary: Woodpaw gnolls hold their den beneath Feralas’s dense canopy, just north of Darkmist Ruins. Their fiercest alphas guard the pack’s home, and travelers crossing the southern wilderness face their threat.

sections.title: Heart of the Pack
sections.body: Woodpaw Den is held by the seasoned alphas of the local gnoll pack. Unlike the smaller scout camps along the jungle tracks, this encampment is defended in force. The gnolls fight to keep their territory from intruders and the encroaching wilderness. Just north of the elven remnants at Darkmist Ruins, the den threatens travelers crossing this part of Feralas.

faq.answer: Woodpaw Den houses Woodpaw gnolls in southern Feralas, just north of Darkmist Ruins. The pack’s dangerous alphas live there.

aliases: what enemies are in woodpaw den
faq.answer: Woodpaw gnolls live at the den. Their formidable alphas lead and defend the pack against outsiders.

aliases: what is next to woodpaw den
faq.answer: Darkmist Ruins lie just south of the encampment. Dense rainforests border the den.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei at Feathermoon Stronghold, you face expanding gnoll packs near ancestral sites like Darkmist Ruins. They call for watchful containment.
As a huntsman at Camp Mojache, you know the vicious Woodpaw clan competes for game and territory in Feralas’s primeval woods.
